message.content: LiHua expresses positive sentiments towards the graphics and gameplay of Black Myth: Wukong. He highlights the impressive visuals as well as the engaging storytelling. Specifically, LiHua describes the combat style as "immersive" and enjoys the blend of graphics and storyline. He also mentions particularly appreciating the boss battles, noting that they are "intense and require a lot of focus." LiHua notes that he was "on the edge of my seat" during one boss fight and looks forward to experiencing more content. Overall, his comments indicate that he is thoroughly enjoying the game's visual and gameplay elements.
